'''January 2000 Provo tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Image Nation, Provo, Utah on 29 January 2000. [[Matthew Jensen]] won it. It is known from Matthew Jensen's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d214">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-provo-utah-1-29-2000d214/ provo-utah-1-29-2000], DeckTech (Matthew "MattJ" Jensen, 31 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-31-provo-utah-1-29-2000d214/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 29 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Image Nation, Provo, Utah
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 13
* '''Winner:''' [[Matthew Jensen]]
